name: FreshRSS
tagline: Follow websites and news through RSS, in one place.
description: FreshRSS gathers the articles of the sites you follow, refreshes them on a schedule, and lets you read them on the web or in any app that speaks the Google Reader or Fever API.
postInstall: Open it and follow the setup: choose SQLite as the database, then create the administrator account.
For mobile apps, allow API access in Settings, Authentication, then set an API password in your profile.

env.prompt: Minutes of each hour when feeds refresh
